name: io.github.zainzaidi37/jotnow
title: Jotnow
description: Save agent output as notes, search saved notes, and retrieve them in Claude Code and Codex.

environmentVariables.name: JOTNOW_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Account API key from jotnow.dev Settings > API keys. Omit if stored with jotnow key or using desktop local capture.

environmentVariables.name: JOTNOW_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Choose account for account tools or local for desktop capture only. Required if both are configured without a saved mode choice.
